definitions.mask: Bit j-1 is an unread sharp site copy after switch j; rows in increasing integer mask order.
definitions.switches: Two signed H ticks followed by an opposite-rail pass. Launch is sharp at 0. Zero field, unwrapped line.
definitions.kernel: All-pass mass for the indicated copy mask. For ideal forcing F and exogenous X the row is kernel[F OR X]. Failure is its complement.
definitions.connected: Upper Boolean difference of kernel; all entries positive. Upper difference of observed means divided entrywise by connected gives Pr(X subset U).
definitions.scope: Independent setting, stable exogenous word law, squared named records, calibrated copy instrument. Boundary correlations allowed. An endpoint copy or fair-count admixture cannot be separated from every rival by these pass rates alone.
definitions.minimality: All proper deterministic settings needed for arbitrary exogenous all-clear weight given the known all-copy rate. The fair random mask permits one parity-tagged signed statistic. The variance is per original trial, including failures.
